verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe got HTTP 200 at docs.orama.com/llms.txt, which returns a structured index of doc pages. Orama also serves an llms-full.txt (docs.orama.com/llms-full.txt) containing full documentation content, so an agent can be pointed directly at either file. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/llms-full.txt files and how to use them with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: A data source identifies a specific set of documents, ideally coming from a single origin.
A project is a set of **data sources** that you want to use for RAG, search, or any other method of retrieval.
